title: Report Struct Layout
prompt:
Given
 
```c
struct S { char a; int b; char c; };
```
 
implement `void program(void)` that prints each member's offset and the struct size:\n \n```\na@0 b@4 c@8 size:12\n```\n \nUse `offsetof` from `<stddef.h>` and `sizeof` — measure, do not hard-code.

tests.name: exact layout line
tests.code:
const char* out = cj_capture(program);
CHECK_STR_EQ(out, "a@0 b@4 c@8 size:12\n");
tests.hint: offsetof(struct S, a) is 0; b sits at its 4-byte alignment; trailing padding grows sizeof to a multiple of 4.

tests.name: padding detected
tests.code:
struct S { char a; int b; char c; };
CHECK_EQ((int)(sizeof(struct S) - (offsetof(struct S, c) + sizeof(char))), 3);
tests.hint: size minus (last member offset + its size) is exactly the trailing padding.

tests.name: compact alternative
tests.code:
struct T { int b; char a; char c; };
CHECK_EQ((int)sizeof(struct T), 8);
tests.hint: Largest-first ordering packs both chars after the int: 4+1+1+2 tail = 8.
